newsitem.title: CANADA: Imperial Oil raises Canada oil prices.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Oil raises Canada oil prices.

text.p: Imperial Oil Ltd said it raised the price it would pay for some grades of crude oil by C$5.00/cubic metre or C$0.79/barrel, effective immediately.

The new prices were listed as follows: Edmonton light sweet C$212.00/cubic metre, or C$33.71/barrel Cromer light sour C$208.00/cubic metre, or C$33.07/barrel Bow River at Hardisty C$188.00/cubic metre, or C$29.89/barrel Midale at Cromer C$196.00/cubic metre, or C$31.16/barrel -- Reuters Calgary Bureau 403 531-1624
